claims: The 2026 Masters has a total purse of $22.5 million.
Rory McIlroy is the winner of the 2026 Masters.
The winner of the 2026 Masters receives $4.5 million.
The $4.5 million winner's prize is the highest in major championship history.
The runner-up of the 2026 Masters receives $2.43 million.
The 2026 Masters distributes payouts among the top 54 players who made the cut.
The 2026 Masters total purse is up $1.5 million from 2025.
The winner's share of the 2026 Masters is 20% of the total purse.
Amateurs do not receive prize money at the 2026 Masters.
Professionals who missed the cut at the 2026 Masters received $25,000.
The 2025 US Open total purse is $21.5 million.
The 2026 Masters total purse surpasses the 2025 US Open total purse.
